answer: Admission climbs a spiral of retirement claims. Every newcomer buys one non-transferable claim from each already seated name; a claim matures only when its seller exits, and early exit forfeits it. The j-th entrant therefore ties up j-1 claims, so k entrants lock k(k-1)/2 units with no pooling or early recovery. A shale cluster cannot recycle internal claims while its clones remain active. Independent holders form a glacier of ordinary claims, and a proven common controller loses the entire spiral.
